name: Hello, Boss!
source:
"Being a hot CEO isn't enough! I need a secretary!"

Kazuo Tachibana is the CEO of Tachibana Liquor and he is in need of a new secretary! With a lucrative business deal about to go down, can Kazuo get along well with his new secretary, satisfy his father's high expectations, AND find love?!

[From [url=https://studio-calamari.itch.io/hello-boss]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“当一个炙手可热的首席执行官还不够！我需要一名秘书！”

立花一夫是立花酒业的首席执行官，他需要一位新秘书！一笔利润丰厚的生意即将达成，一夫能否与新秘书相处融洽，满足父亲的厚望，并找到爱情？！

[来自[url=https://studio-calamari.itch.io/hello-boss]Itch.io[/url]]
